notes.title: [Notice] Game Release Date Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, thank you so much for your patience and support as we work on bringing this game to life.

Due to adjustments in our development schedule, we are postponing the game’s release from the originally planned last week of July to August 27 (Wednesday).

Initially, we had planned to launch the game in Early Access in late July and then release the full version about a month later, after further testing and balancing.

However, after careful consideration, we’ve decided to skip the Early Access phase and move straight to a full release.

As a result, the official release will take place on Wednesday, August 27, during the final week of August.

We sincerely apologize to everyone who was looking forward to the original release date.

We’re doing our utmost to deliver a polished and complete experience, and we truly appreciate your understanding and continued support.

Thank you very much!
